excludedResources.identity: Mutable installation state tied to one worktree, OS, architecture, Bun version and lifecycle attempt; no sealed reusable identity stamp
excludedResources.reason: Each Windows install attempt owns its lifecycle processes in a worker Job Object. Release that tree before clearing partial dependencies or retrying. Never copy install temp data or node_modules across worktrees; only the sealed Bun download cache may be reused.

excludedResources.identity: Workspace-owned Maven settings snapshots; content hashes identify documents, not a reusable version/platform/architecture/toolchain build stamp
excludedResources.reason: Mutable JDT session state may contain credentials and must remain readable until workspace cache eviction or index rebuilding. Never copy or share it across worktrees at any stage.

locations: Homebrew Cellar, Caskroom and download cache
excludedResources.identity: Runtime PATH executable, package-manager ownership and package/version/platform/architecture validated by the owning installer; no worktree build identity stamp
excludedResources.reason: User-managed runtime installations and mutable package-manager caches are outside worktrees. Never copy, symlink, publish or share them through build resource reuse. No copy stage is permitted.

excludedResources.identity: Native plugin output is tied to the host API, Swift toolchain, platform architecture and signing; no reliable worktree identity stamp
excludedResources.reason: Build each official plugin independently in every worktree and validate it with LitheOfficialPluginVerifier; do not copy or symlink it across worktrees.

excludedResources.identity: The npm archive is pinned by language-server.json, but the extracted tool and build cache are mutable packaging state without a worktree publication stamp
excludedResources.reason: Download and verify the PHP language server independently in each worktree; never copy a partially extracted archive or plugin-owned tool cache across worktrees.

excludedResources.identity: Plugin-owned language tools are mutable runtime state bound to an installed plugin version and signing identity, not a worktree build stamp
excludedResources.reason: Do not reuse plugin-owned language tools across worktrees; plugin lifecycle owns installation, replacement and cleanup.

excludedResources.identity: Composer dependencies depend on the test worktree PHP version and dependency resolution without a reliable identity stamp
excludedResources.reason: Install PHPUnit dependencies independently in each worktree; do not copy vendor directories.

excludedResources.identity: Worker plugins are tied to package format, host SDK and Bun build versions without a reliable identity stamp
excludedResources.reason: Build worker plugins independently in each worktree and run verify-windows-plugin-isolation.mjs; do not copy them across worktrees.

excludedResources.identity: Imported plugin source and install state belong to application configuration and have no worktree identity
excludedResources.reason: Do not copy installed worker plugin state across worktrees; uninstall by plugin ID through the application lifecycle.

excludedResources.identity: Mutable user annotations scoped by standardized workspace identity and configured Agent ID; no build, platform, architecture or toolchain stamp
excludedResources.reason: Favorites, custom titles and hidden rows are runtime preferences. Never copy them across worktrees or read Agent files to reconstruct them; exports are user documents, not build resources. No copy stage is permitted.

excludedResources.identity: Inter 4.1 (18 static OTF faces; internal version 4.001) and JetBrains Mono 2.304 (16 static TTF faces) source files tracked by Git; independent of platform architecture and build toolchain. Version and read-only file hashes are checked by BundledUIFontTests; packaged presence is checked by verify-macos-package.sh.
excludedResources.reason: Checkout source files through Git; build packaging copies them before signing. Never copy fonts from another worktree artifact or signed/installed bundle, and never modify them at runtime. No resource reuse copy stage is permitted.

excludedResources.identity: Helper executable is tied to source, Cargo.lock, target triple and signing; runtime connection descriptors contain ephemeral bearer credentials and workspace ownership locks. No reusable build identity stamp.
excludedResources.reason: Build helpers separately before packaging; never copy runtime connection files or locks. Installed helpers remain read-only. There is no permitted worktree copy stage.

excludedResources.identity: Owned by one Java execution: absolute classpath, working directory, JDK version and native encoding. No reusable version/platform/architecture/toolchain identity stamp.
excludedResources.reason: Created exclusively by the platform launch adapter and deleted on preparation failure, cancelled launch, spawn failure or process exit. Never copy, publish or share between worktrees at any stage; installed bundles and JDK directories remain read-only.
